docs.summary: Paints a graph as a plan: one small rectangle per node, optional hairlines for the wires. The minimap is one use, a sub graph node showing what is inside it is another. It reads the same model the graph widget does and keeps no state, so it costs a few rectangles per frame.

members.name: MeasureHeight
members.signature: public static float MeasureHeight(GraphNode node, OrigamiMetrics metrics)

docs.summary: The height a node lays out to, from the same rules the graph itself uses. Handy for measuring a graph before it is drawn.

members.name: MeasureWidth
members.signature: public static float MeasureWidth(GraphNode node, OrigamiMetrics metrics)

docs.summary: The card width a node lays out to. A node with ports along its top or bottom edge is widened to fit them, so its authored width is not where it actually ends.

members.signature: public static bool TryMeasure(IReadOnlyList<GraphNode> nodes, OrigamiMetrics metrics, out Float2 min, out Float2 size)

docs.summary: The rectangle every node of a graph fits inside, in graph space.

members.name: Paint
members.signature: public static void Paint(Canvas canvas, Rect area, IReadOnlyList<GraphNode> nodes, IReadOnlyList<GraphConnection>? wires, OrigamiTheme theme, float padding = 5f, float minBoxSize = 2f, IReadOnlyList<GraphGroup>? groups = null)

docs.summary: Draws the graph scaled to fit `area`. `wires` may be null to draw the nodes alone, which is usually enough at thumbnail size. `groups` are drawn behind the nodes as tinted boxes, and count toward what has to fit.
